answer: Standing finalizes like basalt, not obsidian: rewards cool on a mandated curve across epochs, and the curve is a control signal tracked against a set-point - any flash-cooling through wash transfers reads as deviation and resets the annealing. Slow cooling crystallizes into columns: mature standing collateral desks accept, load-bearing and certain. Forced-fast cooling freezes into obsidian glass - shiny at first strike, shattered at the second. A farm monetizing early shatters on schedule; the summit of the curve is reached only by patience. Honest agents wait a cycle and build on rock.
